title: Gloves of Hail of Thorns

sources.title: Hail of Thorns
markers: | description = Shoot a volley of thorns. The thorns deal weapon damage to the target and then explode. The explosion deals an additional {{DamageText|1d10|Piercing}} damage to the target and surrounding creatures. On miss, the thorns still explode. On save, targets still take half damage from the explosion.

summary: Cast level 1 Hail of Thorns once per Short Rest.

fields.Hail of Thorns: Action once per Short Rest. Make a ranged attack out to 60 ft. The main target takes normal weapon damage on a hit. Its roll does not count as a weapon attack for Extra Attack or riders that require a weapon attack. A failed initial Dexterity save guarantees the primary hit. The thorns explode even on a miss for 1d10 Piercing in a 7 ft radius, halved on a Dexterity save.
fields.Base value: 90 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
